table.name: Case

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid4 - the ROOT (decision 28); exactly one row per run-DB file (one case per database)

row.name: case_number
row.comment: user-facing investigation identifier

row.name: created_at
row.comment: ISO-8601 UTC

table.comment: Decision 28: case -> run -> source -> raw_record -> assertion

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid4 - the only non-deterministic id

row.name: id_case
row.comment: decision 28

row.name: input_path
row.comment: the operator's --input root (decision 24: run grain)

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(path) - decision 38: never the hash (2c); diffable across runs

row.name: path
row.comment: the archive as opened; UNIQUE

row.name: cd_sha256
row.comment: central-directory hash (reuses sqlite/integrity.py fingerprint_zip), INDEXED column - same archive bytes twice = a query/finding (GROUP BY cd_sha256)

table.name: Run-Archive link

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_run, id_archive) - run metadata (decision 38)

row.name: skipped
row.comment: decision 38: opt-in skip, RECORDED - eligible only when a previous run parsed the same cd_sha256 with the same preset set (key+version+definition_digest)

table.comment: Decision 38: one run opens many archives, one archive appears in many runs; every encounter recorded, skips included

table.name: Run-Preset link

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_run, id_preset) - run metadata (decision 39)

table.comment: Decision 39: every preset SELECTED for the run, even when it yields no assertion; run.settings_json carries every operator arg/option

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5 over paths, never the fingerprint

row.name: input_file_path
row.comment: INPUT SOURCE (decision 24): the outermost artefact mATLAS opened

row.name: inner_path
row.comment: chain-inclusive path inside containers (outer.zip!inner.zip!db.sqlite) - R10

row.name: subunit
row.comment: table / sheet / query inside the file

row.name: source_tier
row.comment: primary (acquisition parsed) | secondary (a tool's export parsed)

row.name: data_source
row.comment: DATA SOURCE (decision 24, source grain): where the data originally lived (UFDR/tool manifest device path); NULL for primary acquisitions - projection falls back to the input source

row.name: fingerprint_sha256
row.comment: hash match = finding, never a merge

row.name: raw_json
row.comment: the complete source row, verbatim - incl. every context party

row.name: recovery_source
row.comment: fine origin: live/wal/journal/freelist/freespace - ordered by descending reliability, so it doubles as the confidence signal; digest-excluded, reaches a claim via the join

table.name: Preset

row.name: id
row.comment: content key uuid5(key, version) - decision 27

row.name: key
row.comment: stable preset key

row.name: definition_digest
row.comment: decision 40: sha256 of the canonical preset definition - catches edits without a version bump; skip eligibility compares digests

table.comment: Decision 27: one file matching several presets = one source, many assertions; the preset is a property of the READING

table.name: Assertion

row.name: id_raw_record
row.comment: every claim comes from a record

row.name: id_preset
row.comment: decision 27: which reading produced this assertion

row.name: output_ordinal
row.comment: fan-out position; UNIQUE(id_raw_record, id_preset, output_ordinal) - §2a guard

row.name: id_entity
row.comment: exactly one entity per assertion (UNIQUE); further placed parties = further assertions on the same activity

row.name: id_activity
row.comment: NULL for a standalone observation (GPS fix)

row.name: entity_role
row.comment: the entity's part in the activity: caller | callee | sender | recipient | reporter | subject | ...

row.name: id_spatial
row.comment: nullable: a login has no place; UNIQUE = owned corner

row.name: id_temporal
row.comment: nullable; UNIQUE = owned corner

row.name: entity_position_link
row.comment: CHECK: EntityPositionLink vocabulary (epistemic nuance lives in the three links)

row.name: entity_time_link
row.comment: CHECK: EntityTimeLink vocabulary

row.name: spatial_temporal_link
row.comment: CHECK: SpatialTemporalLink vocabulary

row.name: entity_origin
row.comment: preset_mapped | operator_param (R24)

row.name: deleted
row.comment: the SOURCE's own deletion claim (L1) - distinct from raw_record.recovery_state (R11)

row.name: multiplicity
row.comment: NULL = 1; aggregate records like '137 calls in March' (R15)

row.name: source_label
row.comment: the one per-claim provenance field (decision 24)

row.name: content_hash
row.comment: digest scoped to the preset's reading of this file; repeats legally, never a key

row.name: claim_digest
row.comment: file-independent L1-only digest (R5): overlapping disclosures converge here as a finding

table.comment: linked_entity dropped (decision 17): the attributed party is entity.concerns. UNIQUE(record,preset,ordinal) = the §2a guard + decision 27

table.name: Entity

row.name: id
row.comment: occurrence, never merged

row.name: identifier
row.comment: NORMALIZED at ingest (E.164, lowercase email, ...); NULL for a purely typed mention ('the device'). Convergence = GROUP BY (identifier_type, identifier)

row.name: raw_identifier
row.comment: decision 21: the identifier AS WRITTEN, verbatim - the entity corner's L1 residence on the row itself

row.name: identifier_type
row.comment: which normalization: msisdn | imei | email | plate | account | other | none (decision 17)

row.name: type
row.comment: what the thing IS: device | person | vehicle | camera | case | ...

row.name: concerns
row.comment: the attributed party, fixed at parsing (absorbs linked_entity / decision 12); excluded from both digests

row.name: concerns_origin
row.comment: operator_param | preset_mapped - who specified it

row.name: concerns_uid
row.comment: decision 22: digest of the case-folded/stemmed concerns ('A. Moreau' / 'moreau a.' group together); derived, never a key, excluded from digests

table.comment: Decision 17: one lean row. Normalization + stemming rule-set versions recorded once per run (matlas_meta)

table.name: Activity

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(raw_record_id, activity_ordinal) at ingest; cross-record merging = analysis-time Activity-record link rows

row.name: kind
row.comment: call | message | trip | transaction | incident | ...

row.name: context_json
row.comment: decision 18: preset-mapped activity context (callee, IMEI, recipients...) - canonical JSON, inside the L1 digest projection, projected to the flat counterpart/facets columns

table.comment: One real-world happening AS ONE RECORD describes it at ingest. A call = 2 assertions sharing an activity only when BOTH legs are placed

table.name: Activity-record link

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_activity, id_raw_record)

table.comment: Decision 26: ingest writes EXACTLY ONE row per activity (its own record - the R7 guard as invariant + lint); analysis may attach further records later ('both operators' records describe this call')

table.name: Analysis

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_assertion, method)

row.name: method
row.comment: algorithm + version - a re-run ADDS rows, never mutates

row.name: record_type
row.comment: main | additional (CHECK: RecordType)

table.comment: Decision 19: THE analysis-layer table - the tool's verdict ABOUT an assertion, never inside it. CSV projects the current method's row

table.name: Spatial Expression

row.name: referential
row.comment: encoding / CRS of the raw value: epsg:4326 | geohash | mgrs | address | place_name | cell_ref | asset_ref | region

row.name: spatial_source
row.comment: mechanism (the V1 position_source): GNSS | WiFi | cell | fused | ... - symmetric with temporal_source

table.comment: HEADER only (decision 15): the raw values live in Spatial Component rows; spatial_role is per component (decision 25). For detector records the instrument IS this expression (the camera id is its asset_ref component)

table.name: Spatial Component

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_spatial_expression, ordinal)

row.name: part
row.comment: PRESET field names (decision 23): raw_position | latitude_wgs84 | longitude_wgs84 | altitude_m | horizontal_accuracy_m | vertical_accuracy_m | horizontal_speed_kmh | vertical_speed_kmh | horizontal_speed_accuracy_kmh | vertical_speed_accuracy_kmh | heading_deg | heading_accuracy_deg | beam_azimuth_deg | beam_width_deg | zone | easting | northing. Anything accepted; standard names export-projected

row.name: spatial_role
row.comment: decision 25: the value-group's part in the activity: vicinity | entry | exit | origin | destination | waypoint | ...

row.name: source_field
row.comment: which source column it came from

row.name: raw_value
row.comment: VERBATIM: a geohash = 1 row, lat+lon = 2 rows, DMS = 6 rows

table.comment: Decision 15: one row per contributing source field; accuracy/speed get their structured L1 residence here, canonical numbers at L2

table.name: Temporal Expression

row.name: kind
row.comment: instant | interval | open bound

row.name: referential
row.comment: format / reference system: unix_epoch_s | apple_cfabsolute | iso8601 | excel_serial | local_string | ...

row.name: temporal_source
row.comment: clock mechanism: NTP | internal_clock | ...

table.comment: HEADER only (decision 15): the raw values live in Temporal Component rows; temporal_role + stated_offset are per component (decision 25); granularity dropped - fuzziness lives in the raw value + the integration method

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_temporal_expression, ordinal)

row.name: part
row.comment: PRESET field names (decision 23): lower | upper | duration (+ lower_date/lower_time-style splits). Anything accepted; standard names export-projected

row.name: temporal_role
row.comment: decision 25: THIS bound's part in the activity: start | end | booking | check_in | check_out | last_seen | ... (a visit: lower=check_in, upper=check_out)

row.name: stated_offset
row.comment: decision 25 + R13: the offset the source stated for THIS bound, verbatim TEXT ('+01:00', 'CEST'); NULL = none stated. Decision 9's dual offsets, per bound

row.name: raw_value
row.comment: VERBATIM: date col + time col stay two rows; the integration combines them (datetime_combine method)

row.name: id_spatial_expression
row.comment: derived FROM; UNIQUE = one integration in v1, plural possible later

row.name: method
row.comment: geocoder / cell register / passthrough, with version + reference data

row.name: id_temporal_expression
row.comment: derived FROM; UNIQUE = one integration in v1

row.name: lower_unix_utc_us
row.comment: canonical UTC microseconds

row.name: lower_datetime_iso
row.comment: decision 32: ONE offset-tagged LOCAL ISO string (2026-03-14T02:20:31.000000+01:00); trailing ' N/A' when zone unknown; empty when no instant

row.name: lower_date
row.comment: local date (decision 32)

row.name: lower_time
row.comment: local time-of-day, microseconds (decision 32)

row.name: utc_offset_hours_lower
row.comment: the APPLIED offset: float, 'N/A' assumed-UTC sentinel, or NULL

row.name: utc_offset_hours_upper
row.comment: applied to the upper bound; may differ across DST

row.name: lower_accuracy_us
row.comment: per-bound timing uncertainty (µs): source-stated or the Method's claim

row.name: upper_accuracy_us
row.comment: applied to the upper bound; independent of the lower

row.name: method
row.comment: tz rule / epoch decode / assumed-UTC, with version

row.name: id_spatial_integration
row.comment: 1:1 with the point; UNIQUE

row.name: s2_cell_id
row.comment: decision 31: signed-int64 LEAF S2 cell, NON-unique (many points per cell), INDEXED. Hierarchy implicit in the id -> range scans; built with s2sphere

table.name: Edit log

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid4 - an audit event (decision 34)

row.name: ordinal
row.comment: decision 41: monotonic UNIQUE journal position - inverse replay in reverse order = full rewind; a rewind appends inverse entries, never erases

row.name: row_id
row.comment: the edited row's id (soft reference across tables)

row.name: edit_kind
row.comment: update | new_row | empty_row - evidence rows only new_row/empty_row (decision 34)

row.name: edited_at
row.comment: ISO-8601 UTC

table.comment: Decision 34: manual-edit audit for the edit panel; L0/L1 evidence never updated in place (new-row only); integration/analysis mutable in place
